svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — The only thing going down is the fuel gauge
svg.desc: Black-and-white pen-and-ink newspaper cartoon at a suburban service station under a canopy reading Kookaburra Fuel. A fictional motorist in a checked work shirt and shorts holds an empty wallet upside down beside a fuel bowser as moths flutter out, saying: a quarter tank, please — on lay-by. Behind him a station wagon with a kelpie in the back window is being filled, while a fictional attendant on a ladder fits a new number 3 tile to the price board. Caption: The only thing going down is the fuel gauge.
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
THE ONLY THING GOING DOWN IS THE FUEL GAUGE.
Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, 25 November 2026 — Annual inflation rose to 4.9%, led by fuel, power and housing costs.
